## Why

The original P8 acceptance work and PR queue review produced reproducible evidence that should survive individual Actions artifacts and local sessions. PR #167 has now been merged by `jyqj`, while the original complete scale study is still running. A separate exact Mac workspace check also exposed a reproducible test failure that needs a visible follow-up.

## Changes

This PR adds only `artifacts/checkpoints/p8-a23-closeout-20261009-bfcc/` (443 files at head `255e3b27b8fa1d82d5ebfb95b946cec8ee97528f`). Product code, validation logic, workflows, source pins, original protocols and the canonical TODO ledger are unchanged from current main.

The checkpoint retains:

- The original a23 source and actual CI merge-checkout identities, with full-tree and input equivalence checks.
- Four accepted original scale preflight shards (1k/5k/10k/50k), their original ZIPs and unchanged native validator replays. The complete study is still **4/150 shards, 41/1500 samples** at this snapshot.
- Independently reviewed original mixed-load/backfill, lifecycle/resource, one-hour soak, eight-cell platform, recovery/rollback and failure-gate evidence, including precise concurrency, memory, cost and causal limits.
- The exact original failure-gate artifact and replay provenance; complete large runtime originals remain identified by official artifact IDs, byte counts and SHA-256. Small indices are explicitly not replacement raw streams.
- PR #160/#161/#168/#169 source/adoption inventories, original failures, historical PR inventory and queue-management records.
- The new independently reviewed snapshot candidate's source-admission proof. Its verifier really ran at R plus two binding files; the later G commit is linked by exact-byte proof. The first wrapper timeout remains separately recorded.
- The exact Mac workspace failure, one isolated reproduction and persistent supervisor observation. The initial SDK27 linker failure is retained separately. **The Mac workspace gate has not passed.**

## Current acceptance state

The authoritative ledger remains **192 total = 163 done + 29 remaining**. This session has **zero newly completed original TODOs** so far. The ten target tasks are the original P8-005 through P8-013 plus P8-016; their definitions and hard dependencies remain in force. No reduced sampling, substituted primary, waived deadline, live-provider approval, full-scale completion or release certification is claimed.

The original a23 full-scale run [37872522779](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37872522779) continues against its frozen source. The Mac regression investigation continues separately, as recorded in [#167](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/pull/167#issuecomment-6074384941). This archive can be reviewed independently of those pending tasks.

## Verification

Every copied selection was checked against its exact bytes/SHA-256 before and after copying. The latest addendum contains 81 selected files totaling 2,730,014 bytes, plus its manifest. All 31 README relative links resolve. Git comparison confirms all 443 PR paths are inside the archive namespace and all non-artifact paths are identical to main `b21cce4c8661589267ad5719f850accbec088d2f`. The canonical task blob remains `f400eb2b5a3f8c524978bee1dfa87f98efe4bce8`.

Start with the [checkpoint README](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/255e3b27b8fa1d82d5ebfb95b946cec8ee97528f/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-a23-closeout-20261009-bfcc/README.md).
